facts.text: Six Senses Laamu is the only resort in the Laamu Atoll.
facts.excerpt: swim along the seashell dappled-shores of the only resort in the Laamu Atoll

facts.text: The resort is on the remote Laamu Atoll in the southern Maldives, a seaplane flight away from Male.
facts.excerpt: on the remote Laamu Atoll in the southern Maldives, an awe-inspiring scenic seaplane flight away from Male

facts.text: The resort is on Olhuveli Island.
Guests choose an over-water villa or a beachfront villa among lush vegetation.
facts.excerpt: Choose the soft breezes of an over-water villa or hide among the lush vegetation of a beachfront villa.

facts.text: All villas make the most of natural materials and are designed for space and privacy.
facts.excerpt: All make the most of natural materials, and their clever design allows for the utmost space and privacy.

facts.text: The Maldives Underwater Initiative, a marine conservation initiative, is based at the resort in collaboration with The Manta Trust, Blue Marine Foundation and Olive Ridley Project.
facts.excerpt: Award-winning marine conservation initiative based right here at Six Senses Laamu in collaboration with three partner NGOs: The Manta Trust, Blue Marine Foundation and Olive Ridley Project

facts.text: Surf pros from Tropicsurf offer a surf package for beginners.
facts.excerpt: Let the surf pros from Tropicsurf help you ride the waves. Blending board action with island relaxation, this is the perfect surf package for beginners.

facts.text: Guests can snorkel the house reef and surf the Yin Yang break.
facts.excerpt: How about a morning snorkel on our vibrant house reef followed by an afternoon riding the famous Yin Yang break?

facts.text: Dolphins, rays and parrotfish swim along the resort's shores.
facts.excerpt: Our resident dolphins, rays and parrotfish swim along the seashell dappled-shores

facts.text: The Sunset Dolphin Cruise is on a private dhoni.
facts.excerpt: Step onto your private dhoni, glass of bubbly in hand, for an emotional cruise

facts.text: Coral gardens lie a stone's throw from the Chill Lounge & Bar.
facts.excerpt: Pristine coral gardens lie just a stone’s throw from our Chill Lounge & Bar

facts.text: The Lobster Barbecue on the Beach is grilled by a personal chef beneath the stars.
facts.excerpt: A barbecue grilled by your personal chef beneath a tropical star-filled sky

facts.text: The reef at the resort glows with coral spawning when the moon cycle is right.
facts.excerpt: When the moon cycle is just right, the reef at Six Senses Laamu glows with an incredible natural phenomenon: coral spawning.
